title: ForgeVariables

url.description: The variables holding the canonical origin: FORGE_<SLUG>_URL, and FORGE_URL for the primary.

token.description: The variables holding the token: FORGE_<SLUG>_TOKEN, FORGE_TOKEN for the primary, GH_TOKEN for github.com.

kind.description: The variables holding the kind: FORGE_<SLUG>_KIND, and FORGE_KIND for the primary.

description: The exact names of the variables a forge account injects into a run; all empty for one that injects nothing (identity-changed or needs-credential).
